findings.reason: {due} is formatWakeDue's output (run-detail-model.ts:1611, wired at :1823): a bare clock plus zone, e.g. «10:30 GMT+3», with a date prefix only when the instant is not today. Russian needs «в» before a bare clock — «сработает 10:30» is ungrammatical — and the same-day case is the common one, so this accessible name is wrong on the ordinary row. Adding «в» would break the dated shape («в 10 окт. 10:30»), whereas «запланированное на {due}» governs both. Every other locale supplies the preposition (es «para», vi «lúc», hi «पर», ur «کو», zh «将于»); only fr «prévu {due}» and ru omit it. Alternative that also avoids the grammar: «Отменить пробуждение: {due}», the colon shape mcp_auth.title_for_server and wake.cancel_wake_named already use for a value.

Section label over the subagent's brief (run-child-reader.tsx:386). English 'Delegated with' names the instrument the delegation was made with; «Что делегировано» names the delegated object instead, and above a block of instruction text it reads as a question the block then answers. Sidecar note asks for 'the tools/capabilities a subagent was delegated with', which the current wording also does not name. «Поручение» labels the brief itself, which is what the block holds.

«войти в сервер» is the calque of English 'sign in to'; Russian takes a server with «на» (вход на сервер) and keeps «в» for accounts and systems (войти в систему, войти в аккаунт). Understandable and applied consistently, hence nit. Same call in mcp_auth.title_for_server («Войти в {server}» -> «Войти на {server}») and mcp_auth.no_session («...чтобы войти в этот сервер» -> «...чтобы войти на этот сервер»); mcp_auth.checking «Проверка способа входа в этот сервер…» follows.
